subject: Horizon Health renewal — executive approval requested for retention package
messages:
From: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@horizonhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Khanna <rajiv.khanna@horizonhealth.com>, procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-29T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal negotiation — need flexible package to preserve deployment

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the partnership — we've been happy with the inference performance in production, but budget constraints and an upcoming board review mean we need a materially different commercial posture to move forward. Key asks from my side:

- One-time credit or discount equal to ~20% of their renewal ARR to bridge FY27 procurement.
- Reset the term to 6 months (they want a shorter commitment to re-evaluate performance).
- Add a 99.9% SLA overlay for the next 12 months (they need an availability commitment tied to credits).

I tried to keep this high-level for procurement and legal; legal will do the redlines once we have signoff on commercial levers. If you can provide an executive-approved package I can present it at the board review next Tuesday.

I can share Horizon's redlines and usage reports if helpful (attaching the redline file I have).

Appreciate your help,
Samantha

Attachments: horizon_contract_redlines.pdf (summary of changes from Horizon legal)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal negotiation — need flexible package to preserve deployment [ESCALATION]

Team — forwarding Horizon's ask. Renewal hits next-week board review and they want a quick executive decision. Summary of the request: 20% one-time credit, 6-month term reset, 99.9% SLA add-on.

My read: high strategic value (regional health system, referenceable), but the ask is outside standard retention authority. Proposed options (ranked):
1) Approve $75k one-time credit + 6-month term + SLA overlay (price-protected for one renewal cycle).
2) Approve 10% discount + SLA overlay + extended support play (lower credit but operational commitment).
3) Decline financial concession, offer technical incentives only (trial of dedicated capacity).

Need finance signoff on option 1 and legal to OK SLA language. Vivek — can you weigh in on commercial? Markus — do we have margin headroom for a $75k credit tied to a short term? Tessa — can CS commit to the SLA operationally?

Quote from original: "I can present it at the board review next Tuesday." They really need a packaged response by COB Monday.

-Kim

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal negotiation — need flexible package to preserve deployment [ESCALATION]

Kim — thanks for flagging. Horizon is strategic and public-sector adjacent — we should be willing to make a concession to preserve the reference. My preference is option 1 but let's structure it so credits are conditional on signed renewal and a 6-month term (no auto-roll). Two points:

1) Limit the total credit commitment to $75k and carve out token/embeddings overages from credit coverage.
2) SLA overlay is ok operationally if it's scoped (business hours response + 99.9% uptime measurement + a cap on total credit payout).

Markus — can finance approve a $75k one-time credit spread over Q4 (we can quarter it against bookings)? If not, what band do you authorize?

-Vivek

(quoted material omitted)

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal negotiation — need flexible package to preserve deployment [ESCALATION]

Vivek/Kim — Finance reviewed; we can authorize a one-time credit up to $75,000 COA (cost-of-acquisition style credit) provided:
- It's explicitly one-time and non-recurring.
- It's tied to a signed 6-month commitment and a confirmed PO within 30 days.
- The SLA overlay must include a cap for credit payouts (no more than 50% of the one-time credit) and be tied to monthly measurement windows.

I'll need a short form amendment drafted by legal and a billing memo to recognize the credit. If legal approves SLA language, finance signs off.

-Markus

Onboarding note: Tessa, please confirm we can operationalize the SLA with current oncall and runbooks; if not, call a 30-min playbook review ASAP.

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Rajiv Khanna <rajiv.khanna@horizonhealth.com>, procurement@horizonhealth.com, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Horizon renewal — approved interim retention package and next steps

Samantha — thanks for your patience while we reviewed this with finance and operations. We can move forward with an executive-approved interim package to help Horizon through the board review. Summary of what Redwood can commit to: 

- One-time credit of $75,000 applied at signing (non-recurring).
- Term reset to a 6-month commitment (effective at signature).
- SLA overlay: 99.9% monthly availability target with a defined remediation credit schedule capped at 50% of the one-time credit.

Conditions and next steps:
1) Horizon signs the attached amendment and returns a PO within 30 days.
2) Credits apply only to subscription fees (usage overages excluded).
3) Legal will review and finalize SLA language; our legal contact (copied) will engage Horizon legal for redlines.
4) We will provision a short SLA onboarding playbook and schedule a 60-minute runbook walk-through with your platform team.

Attachments: Horizon_Renewal_Supporting_Package.pdf (details of the offer and operational commitments), executive_one_time_credit.pdf (billing memo and accounting treatment).

If this looks acceptable I will send a DocuSign amendment for signature and set up the technical onboarding call. We hope this gives you the flexibility to present a concrete option to your board.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

-----Forwarded message included above for context.
